scope: finite ordinary trees; fixed integer p >= 2; original leaves, supports, and neighborhoods

definitions.support_multiplicity: m_u=number of original degree-one neighbors of u
definitions.branch_polynomials: For each w adjacent to u, C_w is the w-side component after deleting uw; J_w=I(C_w), A_w=I(C_w-w).

identities.name: leaf_deleted_tree_polynomial
identities.formula: P_{u,v}=product_{w in N(u)\{v}} J_w + z product_{w in N(u)\{v}} A_w = I(T-v)
identities.reason: Partition independent sets by whether u is excluded or included.

identities.name: support_deletion_difference
identities.formula: Q_{u,v}=product_{w in N(u)\{v}} J_w - product_{w in N(u)\{v}} A_w = I(T-{u,v})-I(T-N[u])
identities.reason: After deleting u and v, each remaining branch is unrestricted; after deleting N[u], the root w of each remaining branch is deleted.

identities.name: selected_sum_rewrite
identities.reason: The indicator is exactly Delta_p(T-v)<0; the Q coefficient difference is the contract summand at rank p-1. Since the v branch is a singleton, P and Q are constant across v in L(u), so multiplicity m_u preserves every tagged leaf.

identities.name: rooted_independence_recurrence
identities.reason: Partition independent sets in the rooted subtree by root exclusion or inclusion.

fixed_rank_state.additional_coordinate: alpha(T), computed by the analogous excluded/included maximum recurrence
fixed_rank_state.guard_check: x(T)+2<=p iff at least one Delta_j(T)<0 for 0<=j<=p-2; this uses coefficients through p-1. The strict lower-region guard additionally uses 3p<2alpha(T)+1.
fixed_rank_state.purpose: Sufficient coefficient range for selector and summand evaluations at fixed p, not a bounded universal finite-state theorem.

missing_step: A context-closed transfer state and a proved global sign/compensation inequality for the selected support records. The reduction by itself implies no sign for S.
